name: hornero
description: Role-and-skill methodology for Claude Code: PM reviewer subagent and 59 skills (38 product-management skills + 16 cross-role process skills + 5 command skills; 12 are slash-invocable), including the cross-system `query-issue-tracker` (Linear/Jira) and `query-warehouse` (BigQuery/Snowflake) read primitives, plus three append-shaped skills — hypothesis-track, stakeholder-update, customer-update — that drive the chronicle layer's append exception). Every skill is a real directory at `skills/<name>/`; role membership is the `role:` frontmatter key. Skills opt into external data sources via their frontmatter `resources:` field — each `resources/<slug>/RESOURCE.md` card documents the MCP server install, auth env, and fallback path; Hornero stays usable when no MCP server is configured.
